notes: null max_workers means 'use all but one CPU core'. Complexity stage: each graph's Edmonds time is the median of edmonds_repeats (>= 3) separate calls, so speedups at n >= 20000 are not single-sample; Edmonds is skipped for graphs with more than edmonds_max_n vertices (45000 covers F1/F6 n=40000 and F5 n_param=20000 -> 40284 vertices), and each call is capped at edmonds_timeout_sec (1800s; ~100-350s per call measured at n=20000 on the dev laptop). Gabow runs at every size. The correctness stage keeps its own Edmonds timeout (60s default).
